business_summary: Mitsubishi Estate Logistics REIT Investment Corporation under the (Act on Investment Trust and Investment Corporation) (Investment Trust Law). It was listed on the REIT Securities Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on September 14, 2017. MEL focuses on investing in logistics facilities as a listed real estate investment corporation. Mitsubishi Estate Co., Ltd. (MEC), one of the largest comprehensive developers in Japan, has been acting as a sponsor. MEL's asset management company, Mitsubishi Jisho Investment Advisors, Inc. has an extensive track record in real estate fund management since its establishment in 2001. Through (HYBRID) (Note) utilization of the strengths of both companies, MEL aims for maximization of unitholder value by building of a high-quality portfolio and steady and stable asset management through selective investments in highly competitive logistics facilities that meet tenant needs that focus on location, building features and stability. Furthermore, MEL announced management policy (Three Pillars) on April 17, 2019, as a management plan designed to maximize unitholder value in the medium-to long-term. The management policy is intended to gather the entire MEC Group to work together and increase unitholder value of MEL, focusing on the following three pillars: Alignment (align interest with unitholders), Discipline (disciplined growth) and Hybrid (enhance MEL's unique strategy, the Hybrid model). During the fiscal period ended February 28, 2025, MEL disposed 49% of co-beneficiary interest of MJ Logipark Sendai 1 in September 2024 and acquired MJ Logipark Aisai 1 in October 2024. As a result, MEL owned 35 properties (aggregate total acquisition price: 271,593 million yen), as of the end of the reporting fiscal period (Feb. 28, 2025). Mitsubishi Estate Logistics REIT Investment Corporation was incorporated in Japan on July 14, 2016 and incorporated in Japan.
business_summary_ko: (투자신탁 및 투자회사에 관한 법률)(투자신탁법)에 따른 미쓰비시토지물류 REIT투자주식회사. 2017년 9월 14일 도쿄증권거래소 REIT 증권시장에 상장되었습니다. MEL은 상장 부동산 투자법인으로 물류시설 투자에 주력하고 있습니다. 일본 최대의 종합 개발업체 중 하나인 미쓰비시 에스테이트(MEC)가 후원자로 활동해 왔습니다. MEL의 자산관리회사인 Mitsubishi Jisho Investment Advisors, Inc.는 2001년 설립 이후 부동산 펀드 관리 분야에서 폭넓은 실적을 보유하고 있습니다. MEL은 (HYBRID) (주) 양사의 강점을 활용하여 위치, 건물 기능 및 안정성에 중점을 둔 임차인 요구 사항을 충족하는 경쟁력 있는 물류 시설에 대한 선택적 투자를 통해 고품질 포트폴리오 구축과 꾸준하고 안정적인 자산 관리를 통해 단위 보유자 가치의 극대화를 목표로 합니다. 또한, MEL은 중장기적으로 단위 보유자 가치를 극대화하기 위한 경영 계획으로 2019년 4월 17일 경영 방침(Three Pillars)을 발표했습니다. 관리정책은 MEC G 전체를 모으는 것을 목적으로 합니다.
